title: 使用多智能体视角偏好优化学习性别歧视检测
summary: 提出MAP-PO框架，通过聚类标注者并微调多个LLM智能体，结合个体和团队奖励的偏好优化，保留性别歧视标注中的不同视角。在EXIST 2024数据集上验证，团队级训练信号能保持智能体校准，优于仅个体训练。
summary_en: Proposes MAP-PO framework to preserve diverse perspectives in sexism detection by clustering annotators and fine-tuning multiple LLM agents with preference optimization combining individual and team rewards. Validated on EXIST 2024, showing team-level signal keeps agents calibrated.
